en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning remains in force until 1 p.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory reissued the warning at 10.20 a.m., expecting isolated squally thunderstorms and intense gusts over the territory.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 10.20 a.m. on Tuesday that remained in force until 1 p.m. Isolated squally thunderstorms were expected over Hong Kong, with intense gusts reaching 80 kilometres per hour or above possible.

A special weather tip issued later noted that a rain area was affecting the territory and that heavier rain and localised squally thunderstorms were likely in the early period. Members of the public were advised to seek shelter if outdoors, leave the water, and take precautions against flying debris.

The Observatory said an active southerly airstream was bringing showers and thunderstorms to the Guangdong coast. Temperatures in urban areas were forecast to reach about 32 degrees Celsius with sunny intervals later in the day.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至下午1時 局部有狂風雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台上午10時20分發出雷暴警告，預料本港有局部地區狂風雷暴，並可能有時速80公里或以上強陣風。
body: 天文台於今日上午10時20分發出雷暴警告，有效時間至下午1時，預料香港有局部地區狂風雷暴，並可能有高達每小時80公里或以上的強陣風。
其後發出的特別天氣提示指，一個雷雨區正影響本港，初時雨勢較大及局部地區有狂風雷暴，呼籲市民保持警惕，如身處室外應儘快到安全地方躲避，並提防強陣風及飛散物件。
天文台表示，一股偏南氣流正為廣東沿岸帶來驟雨及雷暴，日間短暫時間有陽光及炎熱，市區最高氣溫約32度。
